description: The line plot, titled “Finetuning for different r, Gazeta,” illustrates the performance of four different model configurations on the ROUGE-1 metric as a function of log r, where r is a hyperparameter likely related to the rank or dimensionality of the LoRA/AdaLoRA adaptation. The x-axis, labeled “log r,” spans from 0 to 9 with integer tick marks at every 1 unit, indicating a linear scale of the logarithm of r. The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1,” ranges from 0 to 35 with major gridlines and tick labels every 5 units. Four distinct lines represent the configurations: “T5 + LoRA” (red circles, solid line) starts at approximately ROUGE-1 = 23.5 at log r = 0 and remains relatively flat, peaking slightly around log r = 6 at ~24.5 before declining to ~24 at log r = 9. “MBart + LoRA” (blue circles, solid line) begins at ~5, dips to ~2.5 at log r = 2, then rises sharply to ~23 at log r = 9. “T5 + AdaLoRA” (green circles, solid line) starts at ~23.5, increases steadily to ~29.5 at log r = 9. “MBart + AdaLoRA” (orange circles, solid line) begins at ~5, rises steeply to ~33 at log r = 4, and then plateaus near 34 for log r from 6 to 9. All lines use circular markers and solid lines, with no error bars or shading. The legend is positioned in the upper left, and the plot includes a light gray grid for easier value estimation.
